answer: Give an identity weight only from attestations a farm cannot print: it needs k peers sharing no inviter within five hops, and a peer may back at most one member of any funding root. A peer caught backing a collapsing cluster forfeits its own attestations, so honest peers price each extra head above the last and the bill outruns the head count. One meadow of clones shares one willow stump; a lantern finds that stump before the close.
